spans.s:
बत 1. बत, ind. (in the later language
वत), Ved. an interjection of astonishment, sorrow,
or regret, generally translatable by ah! oh! O! alas!
alack! wo! woe! (the word बत seems originally
to have stood immediately after the idea beginning
the sentence and giving rise to the interjection, e. g.
बतो बतासि यम, alas! thou art a weak person, O
Yama.) According to native lexicographers the
senses in which बत may be used are expressed by
the following Sanskrit words, खेद, अनु-कम्प,
अनु-क्रोश, वि-स्मय, आश्चर्य, सन्-तोष, धृति,
आ-मन्त्रण, निन्दा, सम्-बोधन.

बत 2. बत, अस्, m. (probably for वत,
past pass. part. of rt. वन्, q. v.), Ved. (according to
the Nirukta) a weak or feeble person.
